cohort: Neonates born via forceps delivery to mothers with cephalic fetuses were recruited from July 2020 to June 2022.
finding: The overall incidence of detectable mild ophthalmological lesions after forceps delivery was 16.9%, with most resolving with conservative management.
mod_finding: External ophthalmic injuries were common after forceps delivery, with higher incidence associated with right or left occipital fetal head positions and more marked fetal head moulding.
